name: Metformin
executiveSummary: Biguanide antihyperglycemic. Adult: start **500 mg PO 1–2/day** with meals; usual maintenance **1–2 g/day** (max **2.55–3 g/day**). Pediatrics ≥10 years: start **500 mg/day**. Stop if lactic acidosis risk (renal failure, hypoxia).
indications:
## Indications

- Type 2 diabetes (often first-line oral).
- PCOS / prediabetes in selected contexts.

## Precautions

- **Lactic acidosis** — contraindicated if low CrCl (often <30), severe liver failure, sepsis, hypoxia.
- Hold before iodinated contrast per protocol.
- GI upset common — titrate slowly.

adulto.dose: Start: **500 mg PO 1–2 times/day** with meals; increase weekly. Usual maintenance **1000–2000 mg/day**. Max often **2550–3000 mg/day**.
adulto.administration: PO with meals. ER often once daily with evening meal.

pediatrico.dose: ≥10 years: start **500 mg/day**; up to **2 g/day** in 2–3 doses.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Diarrhea, nausea, flatulence, metallic taste; B12 deficiency; rare lactic acidosis.
